user_saw: The CLI said manual entry was required after about 16 seconds even when browser sign-in could still finish, and it also waited that long to offer a paste prompt when the callback port was unavailable.
summary: The fix tells users they can finish in the browser while the callback listener is active, confirms successful sign-in after the paste prompt opens, and offers immediate manual entry if the listener cannot start.
reasoning: The oldest readable version already printed “Manual OAuth entry required” while the browser callback could still complete sign-in. The October refactor removed an immediate fallback branch, but its parent set the flag that bypassed that branch whenever it announced browser sign-in, even after a bind failure. The offline history ends before the misleading wording was introduced, so I could not verify its introducing diff or establish that either symptom was a regression.
